newsitem.title: USA: Cyrix president, ceo Jerry Rogers resigns.
newsitem.headline: Cyrix president, ceo Jerry Rogers resigns.

text.p: Cyrix Corp said Jerry Rogers resigned as president and chief executive, effective immediately.
The company did not specify why Rogers, who will remain on the company's board, resigned.
Officials from the company were not immediately available to comment.
Jay Swent, the company's senior vice president of finance and administration, will temporarily replace Rogers as president until the company finds a permanent replacement.
The company will retain an executive search firm to replace Rogers, it added.
